summary.text: Danny Sterling is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 27 since November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Danny Sterling assumed office on November 21, 2018, succeeding Josh Cockroft.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Judiciary and Public Safety Oversight Committee and the Appropriations and Budget Committee, and he has served on the Appropriations and Budget Committee in earlier sessions as well.
